text.p: Fahnestock Viner Holdings Inc said Wednesday its wholly-owned subsidiary FMCC Acquisition Corp began its tender offer for all of the outstanding common stock of First of Michigan Capital Corp.
Stock holders who tender their shares will be entitled to receive $15.00 in cash per share. The tender offer and withdrawal rights are scheduled to expire on Wednesday, July 16 unless extended.

As previously announced, FMCC has agreed to buy, and certain First of Michigan stockholders have agreed to sell, about 57 percent of the outstanding common stock of First of Michigan for the same price as the tender.
The Bank of New York is the depositary for the tender offer. Fahnestock & Co Inc is the dealer manager and Beacon Hill Partners Inc is the information agent.

The company said it expects Albert Lowenthal, chairman and chief executive of Fahnestock, will be appointed chief executive of First of Michigan by its board upon completion of the tender offer and closing of the purchase and sale.
